verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; cost per lead is up and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 109 leads at an average cost of $7.24 per lead, but the most recent 7 days saw lead volume fall 34% versus the prior 7 days — with spend barely changed, meaning fewer leads per dollar, not a budget cut. At the same time, your Google Business Profile engagement went to zero for the last 8 days of the period, removing an organic floor that had been generating roughly 9 actions per day through August. Ad creative and audience targeting on the retargeting campaign are being reviewed this week to reverse the efficiency drop, and Google Business Profile activity is being reactivated to restore that organic layer. The last three days of the period showed a modest lead uptick — a signal worth watching, though it is too early to call a reversal.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead spiked 47% in 7 days as lead volume fell sharply, compounded by Google Business Profile engagement going completely dark since September 1.
watch_item.fix: Ad audiences and creative are under review this week for fatigue, and Google Business Profile reactivation is in motion to restore the organic lead floor.
